context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14 adds complete wallet system (topup, pay, transfer, refund), coupon system (validate, apply, list), and history page. Key features: 1) Wallet API at /api/wallet with topup max 200 EUR, pay with balance check, transfer between users, refund. 2) Coupon API at /api/coupons with validate (percentage/flat discounts), apply (marks as used), per_user_limit enforcement. 3) Config API returns 90+ production configs as dict, 10 cancel reasons with French translations, 10 vehicle categories including delivery. 4) WalletPage.js shows balance card, topup sheet with preset amounts, coupons section. 5) HistoryPage.js shows rides/orders tabs with filters. NOTE: Wallet topup does NOT use Stripe - it directly credits the wallet (Stripe integration planned for later).
